transcript: Yesterday my friend Chris and I went to see flex at Lincoln Center, a place that in Arkansas in the 90s following a high school basketball team trying to get to the state championship. Much of the drama of the play comes from the social politics among the team members as they navigate adolescents egos and jealousy and the hopes for their futures. With most of the characters being in their teens, the plays full of both funny digs at one another as well as hard hitting questions. This was a really great piece that I would definitely recommend. It's playing at Lincoln Center through August 20th with that another playbill for my collection.
